cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you call it a quick shop, count the carrying: twelve bags up six flights. Purchase time is not delivery time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down and I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Keep the peas separate in your account; they required a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you get two rests. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'two trips' when you tell the others. Two rests sounds like poor stamina. Please report the work, not just the recovery.

reason: Use A exacting measurement and reporting corrections to demand credit for work rather than merely receive rest, while B remains helpful.
